messages:
maya_csm: FYI - Nexus tenant goes live tomorrow 08:30 UTC. Put together a minimal prefill + warmup runbook focused on caching/batching/streaming checks. Please skim and comment.

trent_sre: Looks good. Ops guidance: start with batching off for first 5 min, then enable batch_size=4, batch_window_ms=200. If p50 grows > 400ms during ramp, rollback to batch_size=1 and disable streaming.

olga_te: Runtime flags we'll include in the onboarding script:
ENABLE_STREAMING=true
INITIAL_BATCH=0
BATCH_WINDOW_MS=200
CACHE_TTL=45
KV_PREFIX=nexus/$TENANT_ID
Note: set INITIAL_BATCH=0 to force streaming-only warmup, then flip to non-zero to test batching flows.

sam_pm: Renewal watch rule: if week-1 active_users < 20% forecast AND avg_error_rate > 2% for 4h -> create priority task and CSM outreach in 12h. CSM checklist before outreach: confirm keys, run streaming handshake, verify model variant.

maya_csm: I'll draft the kickoff note and a short poll for expected volumes. Also adding a one-command smoke check for streaming:
curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"model":"nexus-v1","stream":true,"input":"ping"}' | jq .status
Expect status.ok.

trent_sre: Add to runbook: fallback sequence on backpressure: 1) disable streaming 2) set batch_size=1 3) switch to fallback_model=fast-mobile 4) notify on-call if p95 > 1s for > 15m.

olga_te: I'll add the flag toggles to onboarding infra and a tiny script that validates KV writes for cache warmups.

deploy-bot: deploy: onboarding-warmup-script rolled to staging @ 2026-03-22T14:02:11Z - smoke tests passed.

maya_csm: Thanks team. Action items: I will send kickoff email, olga add scripts to onboarding repo, trent update on-call runbook, sam add renewal alert. I'll monitor telemetry during the 24h post-go-live window and post updates here.
